---
title: "Hometown map"
---

## About

This page documents Rick Gilmore's explorations of the best ways to create a map of his hometowns over the years.

## Setup

Load packages.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidygeocoder)
library(maps)
library(ggrepel)
library(dplyr)
```

## Load data

```{r}
homes_df <- readr::read_csv("../include/csv/gilmore-hometowns.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## Clean data

```{r}
homes_df <- homes_df |>
  mutate(full_address = paste(city, state, "USA", sep = ", ")) |>
  mutate(n_years )
```

## Fetch lat/lon

```{r}
geocoded_homes <- homes_df %>% 
  geocode(address = full_address, method = 'osm', lat = latitude, 
          long = longitude)
```

## Create map

```{r}
#| label: fig-gilmores-journey
#| fig-cap: "Rick Gilmore's hometowns. The size of the points is proportional to the number of years lived in each location. Created with assistance from AI."
us_map <- map_data("state")

# 5. Build and render the visualization
ggplot() +
  # Draw the background map layer of the United States
  geom_polygon(
    data = us_map,
    aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group),
    fill = "#f2f2f2",
    color = "#d3d3d3",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  
  # Draw paths/lines connecting your homes chronologically based on the year
  geom_path(
    data = geocoded_homes %>% arrange(year),
    aes(x = longitude, y = latitude),
    color = "#4a90e2",
    linewidth = 1,
    alpha = 0.7,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  
  # Plot points for each home location
  geom_point(
    data = geocoded_homes,
    aes(x = longitude, y = latitude, size = n_years),
    color = "#e056fd",
    # size = 4,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  
  # Add smart labels that show the City name and the Year you moved there
  geom_label_repel(
    data = geocoded_homes,
    aes(
      x = longitude,
      y = latitude,
      label = paste0(city, " (", year, ")")
    ),
    box.padding = 0.5,
    point.padding = 0.5,
    size = 3.5,
    fill = "white",
    color = "#333333"
  ) +
  
  # Configure map projections and clean up visual clutter
  coord_quickmap() +
  theme_void() + # Removes grid lines, axis ticks, and backgrounds
  labs(title = "Places I've Called Home",
       subtitle = "A chronological journey across the country",
       caption = "Data mapped using tidygeocoder & ggplot2") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5, 
                              margin = margin(b = 5)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, 
                                 color = "gray40", margin = margin(b = 15))
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

```
